# Northline Contracting

Northline Contracting is a licensed and insured residential contractor serving Portland, Oregon and nearby communities including Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Tigard, Milwaukie, and West Linn.

## Services

- Decks and outdoor spaces
- Home additions
- Siding and exterior repair
- Kitchen and bath updates
